title: Safe Personal RSI: Evaluating and Repairing Personal-Agent Updates
abstract: arXiv:2611.23651v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Kicker is a personal health assistant. Changes to an assistant's reusable instructions can improve task handling while changing what it discloses, which requests it follows, and how it reports actions. We study Safe Personal RSI, an update-evaluation component developed for Kicker. We restrict recursive self-improvement (RSI) to prompt updates, with model weights and runtime code fixed. The procedure tests proposed and current instructions, repeats failing cases, temporarily undoes changes to guide repairs, and checks safety and task performance before adoption. If no version passes, the current instructions stay in use. Our executable benchmark contains 29 email, calendar, health, and marketplace cases, with separate probes for authorization reuse, memory, and tool-output injection. Across three models and two deliberately risky edits, the procedure rejects 20 of 21 update attempts. In repair confirmation, an admitted GPT-5.6 Luna rep

translated_title: 安全个人RSI：评估与修复个人智能体更新
translated_abstract: Kicker是一个个人健康助手。对助手可复用指令的更改可以在改进任务处理的同时，改变它所披露的内容、它遵循的请求以及它报告操作的方式。我们研究了Safe Personal RSI，一个为Kicker开发的更新评估组件。我们将递归自我改进（RSI）限制在提示词更新的范围内，模型权重和运行时代码保持固定。该流程测试提议的指令与当前指令，重复失败的案例，临时撤销更改以指导修复，并在采纳前检查安全性和任务性能。如果没有版本通过，则继续使用当前指令。我们的可执行基准测试包含29个电子邮件、日历、健康和市场案例，并设有针对授权复用、记忆和工具输出注入的独立探测。在三个模型和两次故意设置的风险编辑中，该流程拒绝了21次更新尝试中的20次。在修复确认中，一个被接纳的GPT-5.6 Luna rep（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出Safe Personal RSI更新评估机制，通过将递归自我改进限制在提示词层面、固定模型权重与代码，并建立“测试—修复—验证”流程，在29个案例的基准上成功拒绝了21次高风险更新尝试中的20次，保障个人智能体更新后的安全性与任务性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Safe Personal RSI, an update-evaluation and repair procedure that restricts recursive self-improvement to prompt changes with fixed model weights and code, rejecting 20 of 21 risky update attempts across a 29-case benchmark to ensure safety and task performance before adoption.
